name: engram-mdb
description: Markdown-native agent memory and knowledge database

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=4 --test-timeout=600000 dist/tests/*.test.js dist/tests/search/*.test.js dist/tests/security/*.test.js dist/tests/memory/capture.test.js dist/tests/memory/remote-spool.test.js dist/tests/memory/physical-merge.test.js dist/tests/memory/typed-ops.test.js dist/tests/memory/default-workspace.test.js dist/tests/memory/project-binding.test.js dist/tests/memory/project-init-v2.test.js dist/tests/memory/user-setup.test.js dist/tests/memory/session-context.test.js dist/tests/memory/file-sync.test.js dist/tests/memory/hardening.test.js dist/tests/memory/handoff-hook.test.js dist/tests/memory/codex-trust.test.js dist/tests/memory/preference-lifecycle.test.js dist/tests/memory/recall.test.js dist/tests/profile/insights.test.js dist/tests/memory/handoff.test.js dist/tests/dream/*.test.js dist/tests/adaptive/*.test.js dist/tests/helpers/*.test.js dist/tests/wiki/*.test.js dist/tests/query/operators.test.js dist/tests/query/vault.test.js dist/tests/query/parity.test.js dist/tests/query/security.test.js dist/tests/query/recovery.test.js dist/tests/query/fuzz.test.js dist/tests/unix/parity.test.js dist/tests/unix/features.test.js dist/tests/unix/sandbox.test.js
scripts.test:e2e:browser: npm run build && MDB_E2E_BROWSER=1 node --test dist/tests/dashboard-e2e/*.test.js
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test:reliability: npm run build && node --test dist/tests/acid/*.test.js dist/tests/isolation/*.test.js dist/tests/fuzz/*.test.js dist/tests/backups/*.test.js
scripts.test:backends:live: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/tests/s3.test.js dist/tests/postgres-search.test.js
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && npm run verify:acid && npm run verify:security && npm run verify:search && npm run verify:intelligence && npm run verify:recovery && npm run verify:memory && npm run verify:profile && npm run verify:wiki && npm run verify:dream && npm run verify:adaptive && npm run verify:query && npm run verify:unix && npm run verify:platform && npm run verify:suite-inventory && npm run verify:release
scripts.verify:xhost: npm run build && node scripts/xhost/run.mjs && node scripts/xhost/report.mjs
